- Late fee counted (card_catchup_late_fee_figure): Interior Standard flat 20.00, max 45.00, 20% × 125.00 = 25.00 → above flat, not above max → 25.00.
- Period late fees (card_catchup_period_late_fees): no second late fee posted; charge day 10-20 is 15 days after 10-05 ≥ second-late-fee day count 15 → late fee + second late fee = 25.00 + 15.00 = 40.00.
- Courtesy waiver (card_catchup_courtesy_waiver): latest waiver (10-13) references the declined period's first late fee → leave out the posted late fee 25.00.
- Lien-process fees (card_catchup_lien_process_fees): no lien notice fee posted; charge day 15 days < 35; overlock fee posted for 10-05 → overlock fee alone 25.00.

- Root: parking notice for 2026-11-20 (customer's request).
- Hop P1 — **state-derived**. Sentence (parking_varying_amount_notice_tool_42102484): "The parking notice amount is set only once every parking draft returned for insufficient or uncollected funds that may not be presented again carries a catch-up amount on the authorization's notice history for the parking agreement's oldest unpaid due date." Records: due 2026-09-20 = `delinquent_since`; two settled attempts both returned (R01, R09_uncollected_funds); failed_draft_and_return_figures "Times one returned entry may be presented again: Personal Savings ACH 1" and parking_catchup_rent_recollected "Settled attempts at which the entry may not be presented again: 2" → may not be presented again; find_autopay_notices shows no varying-amount notice for 2026-09-20 → state unmet. Write found by the state words "catch-up amount … notice history": parking_returned_draft_catchup_approval_3f8ea8ec "The approval is recorded on the authorization's notice history as a varying-amount notice for the returned parking due date stating the parking catch-up amount." Eligibility there: returned "for insufficient or uncollected funds", authorization active → tenant approves (owner=user tool).
- Hop P2 — **state-derived**. Sentence (same doc): "No parking notice amount is fixed until every card draft on the tenant's storage unit AutoPay authorizations in active status that is still declined after its last retry carries a catch-up charge on that authorization's notice history." Records: unit authorization `6f2263d9…` Debit Card, active; due 2026-10-05 attempts 1–3 declined_insufficient_funds; Debit Card "Retries after the first attempt, per due date 2" → still declined after last retry; no varying-amount notice on that authorization → state unmet. Eligibility: declined for insufficient funds, active.
- Neither catch-up document states a prerequisite of its own, so the tree has depth 1: {P1, P2} → root; P1 and P2 unordered between themselves.
- No hop is pre-solved: neither prerequisite sentence names a tool, an action or another document; the tools appear only in their own documents.
- Counter-proof "do only the notice": the two sentences make the parking notice amount "not yet set"/"not fixed" while either state is unmet; sending 605.64 (or 615.00) at once leaves the governed result in a state the visible rule forbids.
- Closest alternatives excluded: (i) paying the parking past-due (`pay_parking_past_due`) or the unit balance (`restore_unit_good_standing` / `pay_unit_returned_balance`) writes ledger payments, not "a catch-up amount/charge on the authorization's notice history", so it does not satisfy the sentences; (ii) waiting for a re-presentment — excluded, none remains; (iii) waiting for a card retry — excluded, retries exhausted; (iv) agent sending the catch-ups itself — the approval tools are tenant-owned ("the customer themselves runs it").
